Dr. Brett Beckman, a renowned veterinary dentist, holds notable titles within the field and specializes in dental surgery and pain management. His mission is to enhance care in general practice through education and resources. He is dedicated to improving veterinary dentistry standards and has helped professionals all over the world with their dentistry training.

Dr. Brett Beckman and his team of IVDI Instructors offer veterinary dental RACE-accredited CE courses and training classes to all veterinarians and technicians.

CE for Veterinarians and Technicians Interested in Veterinary Dentistry
